archimate:Gap.documentation:
Bespoke Ubuntu Containers & Databases: Which specific custom microservices connect to Azure SQL Managed Instance versus in-cluster caches (like Redis) or external PostgreSQL databases?
Shared Services Communication Protocols: Are consuming applications calling the Common Services (Payment, Location, Notification) directly via internal Kubernetes DNS (cluster.local) or through the NGINX Ingress / Azure API Management layer?
External Oracle Database Location: Where is the external Oracle DB hosted (on-premises in a legacy data center or in a third-party Azure tenant)?
Kubernetes Namespace Structure: What is the exact namespace layout and naming convention for bespoke Linux workloads (similar to hilo-{env}-01-ns used for Property Consents)?
Common Services Operations & Support: What are the finalized Service Desk resolver groups, Escalation Matrices, and Backup/DR processes for the Common Components (CCPAY, CCNOT, Location)?
Shared Services Interfaces: What specific REST, gRPC, or event-driven interfaces are exposed by the Workflow, Partner, and Maintenance Page common services?
